**Elements:**
- **Customer** (person) — looks up parcel status
- **Parcel Tracker** (software system, ours) — the platform
  - **Web Portal** (container) — customers look up shipments
  - **Dispatch Service** (container) — assigns parcels to couriers
  - **Shipments Database** (container) — stores shipments & dispatch records (we operate)
- **Pricing Rules Library** (software system, shared, ours) — computes prices from weight & zone
- **Email Delivery Provider** (software system, external org)

**Relationships:**
- Customer → Web Portal (looks up status)
- Web Portal → Pricing Rules Library (embeds)
- Dispatch Service → Pricing Rules Library (embeds)
- Dispatch Service → Email Delivery Provider (sends notification emails)
- Web Portal → Shipments Database (stores/retrieves shipments)
- Dispatch Service → Shipments Database (stores dispatch records)
